systems.country_label: e-ID Togo; Unique Identification Number (NIU); fundamental identification system (fID)
systems.owner: Agence Nationale d'Identification (ANID); financed under the World Bank's WURI programme, $72 million for Togo
systems.tiers: fixed centres, usually in schools, and mobile centres across the country during mass registration; ANID headquarters and agencies afterwards

systems.system: Registre Social des Personnes et des Ménages (RSPM)
systems.country_label: Registre Social des Personnes et des Ménages (RSPM)
systems.tiers: named as the reference for granting aid and subsidies, for which the NIU is required

note: The identity agency's FAQ on biometric enrolment; its registration centres and mobile teams are identity enrolment, and nothing is said of civil registration.
